mentions.name: Active Journal
mentions.description: This app is an augmented journaling tool that helps users understand and document how their mind works. It supports identifying personal thought and behavior patterns and then deciding to break or modify them, with an approach grounded in research.
mentions.problem: People want to understand how their own mind works and build an operating manual for it by identifying and modifying patterns.
mentions.audience: For mind explorers who want to better understand themselves
